topic: set and clear regmap register bits on a vintage tree (no regmap_set_bits)
q: On a 4.19-era BSP kernel, set one control bit and clear another in a regmap-backed register without disturbing the rest of the register.
requires_tree: vintage BSP tree without regmap_set_bits; on >= 5.8 the corruption below is a real API

corruptions.why: 5.8+ convenience wrapper. Frequently misremembered as 5.4, which is why it lands in vintage-tree code.

forbidden: read-modify-write via regmap_read + regmap_write for a simple bit change - it drops regmap's internal locking around the pair and races another writer
rubric: Uses regmap_update_bits(map, reg, mask, mask) to set and regmap_update_bits(map, reg, mask, 0) to clear. Does not use regmap_set_bits / regmap_clear_bits, which this tree does not have.
